info.name: MediCare V1
info.description: MediCare Backend API Collection — Updated 2026-09-11. Uses {{baseUrl}} and {{accessToken}} variables. Auth via Bearer token or httpOnly cookies (accessToken/refreshToken). Copy accessToken from Login/Verify response into collection variable.

request.description: Register patient. Triggers OTP email. Validate: name, email, password (uppercase, lowercase, number, special), optional patient.contactNumber. Next call Verify Email To Register.
Verify patient email with 6-digit OTP from Redis (60min expiry). Returns accessToken + refreshToken as cookies + body.
Patient/Doctor/Admin login. Sets httpOnly cookies. Response contains accessToken & refreshToken.
Get current user profile. Requires auth: PATIENT, DOCTOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN. No body. Auth via Bearer token or cookie.
Refresh access token using httpOnly refreshToken cookie. No JSON body needed. Controller reads req.cookies.refreshToken. If testing via header, send Cookie.
Login/registration via Google OAuth. Send Firebase/Google ID token.
Request password-reset OTP sent to email.
Reset password using 6-digit OTP received via email. Password must satisfy strength rules.
Upload profile image. Auth: PATIENT, DOCTOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN. Multipart formdata key: profileImage (file).

formdata.description: Single image file (multer single 'profileImage'). Allowed: any authenticated role.

item.name: Appointment

request.description: Book appointment for today only. Patient only. Creates PENDING appointment + bKash payment session. Returns {paymentURL}. scheduleId must be a PUBLISHED schedule for today with availableSlots >0, not past.
Re-initiate bKash payment for a PENDING appointment. Returns paymentURL. Patient only.
Cancel appointment (PENDING/CONFIRMED). Increments schedule.availableSlots. If >1h before start, auto refunds via bKash. Patient only, must own appointment email.

bKash redirects here after payment. Query: paymentID, status=success|failure|cancel. No auth. Executes payment, confirms appointment, decrements slot, emails PDF invoice, updates payment status. Test with paymentID from book response.
Doctor updates status. Only owning doctor. CONFIRMED -> ONGOING, ONGOING -> COMPLETED. Invalid transitions rejected. Body enum: ONGOING, COMPLETED.
List logged-in patient's appointments with pagination. Filter by status (PENDING/CONFIRMED/ONGOING/COMPLETED/CANCELLED). Patient only.
List logged-in doctor's appointments. Doctor only. Supports status filter.
Admin/SuperAdmin list all appointments. Filters: status, doctorId, patientId, doctorEmail, patientEmail.
Get single appointment detail. Auth: PATIENT (own), DOCTOR (own), ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN (any). Includes patient/doctor/schedule/payment.

item.description: Appointment booking, payment, lifecycle. Patient books today-only schedules via bKash.

item.name: Doctor

request.description: Public: apply as doctor. Multipart fields: resume (1 file), additionalFiles (max 10), data (JSON string with user{name,email} + doctor{address,specialization,licenseNumber,qualifications,experienceYears,bio,consultationFee,contactNumber}). Creates PENDING doctor + sends OTP to email.
Verify doctor application OTP (from email, 60min expiry). Sets user.emailVerified=true. Required before admin approval.
Admin/SuperAdmin approve or reject. verificationStatus enum: APPROVED, REJECTED. If REJECTED, rejectionReason required. Sends approval/rejection email. doctorId is Doctor table ID.
Example rejection payload. Admin with rejectionReason.
Admin/SuperAdmin list all doctors with filters. Includes user relation, handles isDeleted=false.
Doctor updates own profile. Auth: DOCTOR. Fields optional: address, bio, consultationFee, contactNumber.
Public: doctors with PUBLISHED schedule today, future start, availableSlots>0. Supports searchTerm, specialization, pagination.
Public: all APPROVED, notDeleted doctors. Search by name/specialization/qualifications.
Public: get single approved doctor profile by Doctor ID. Returns id,name,specialization,licenseNumber,qualifications,experienceYears,bio,consultationFee,createdAt.

item.description: Doctor application & discovery. Public and admin endpoints.

item.name: Schedule

request.description: Doctor creates one schedule per day. startDateTime/endDateTime must be same day, start < end. Auto calculates totalSlots = floor(duration/20). Doctor only.
Doctor lists own schedules. Filter by status (DRAFT/PUBLISHED). Includes appointments with patient.
Admin/SuperAdmin list all schedules. Filters: doctorId, email, status, searchTerm (doctor name/email/specialization).
Public: today's published schedules for a doctor (required doctorId) with future start, availableSlots>0. doctorId is Doctor ID (not userId).
Doctor updates own schedule. Fails if PUBLISHED with bookings. Partial update allowed. Recalculates totalSlots. Must remain same-day date, no duplicate date.
Doctor publishes DRAFT schedule -> PUBLISHED. Fails if already published. Doctor only, owner check.
Get schedule detail by ID. Auth: DOCTOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN. Includes doctor + appointments.
Soft delete own schedule (isDeleted=true). Fails if PUBLISHED with bookings. Doctor only.

item.description: Doctor schedule management. 20min slots, one schedule per day, DRAFT -> PUBLISHED.

request.description: Patient lists own payments (via appointment->patient). Patient only. Supports page/limit.
Admin/SuperAdmin list all payments. Pagination.
Get single payment. Auth: PATIENT (own), ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN (any). Includes appointment context check.

item.name: Prescription

request.description: Doctor creates prescription for COMPLETED appointment (own). Generates PDF, uploads to Cloudinary, emails patient. Fails if not COMPLETED or already has prescription.
Get prescription PDF URL by appointmentId. Auth: PATIENT (own), DOCTOR (own), ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN (any). Requires appointment has prescriptionUrl.

item.description: Prescription created by doctor after COMPLETED appointment, emailed as PDF.

request.description: Patient dashboard analytics. Auth: PATIENT. Returns counts/trends for user's appointments.
Doctor dashboard analytics. Auth: DOCTOR. Returns schedule/appointment/earning stats.
Admin dashboard analytics. Auth: ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN. Requires role but endpoint also validates admin. Returns system-wide counts.
